# `slice`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
slice(x, start, length)
```

Subsets array x starting from index start (array indices start at 1, or starting from the end if start is negative) with the specified length.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT slice(array(1, 2, 3, 4), 2, 2);
```

Result:

```text
[2,3]
```

```sql
SELECT slice(array(1, 2, 3, 4), -2, 2);
```

Result:

```text
[3,4]
```
